title: Database import does not complete successfully due to incorrect SQLite database corruption error
symptom: When re-installing the xDrip app and loading a previous database backup, the import does not complete successfully. The database file is not fully copied, and after reloading the app, SQLite reports database corruption errors such as 'database disk image is malformed'.
cause: The database is closed after renaming the imported backup to the sqlite database file, causing a race condition that appears more frequently with larger databases.
fix: The issue was resolved by opening a PR to fix the race condition; the user reported that on the latest release the error did not occur.
evidence_quote: which appears because the database is closed _after_ renaming the imported backup to the sqlite database file, causing a race condition which seems to appear more frequently the larger the size of your database. I am opening a PR to resolve this issue.
